name: Weyerhaeuser
outlook:
What Weyerhaeuser says to expect

  • Full year 2026: Adjusted EBITDA and basisThe company continues to expect full year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA to be approximately $450 million, a $25 million increase from the initial outlook, and basis as a percentage of Strategic Land Solutions sales to be 15 to 20 percent for the full year.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
